preconditions.description: N is a positive integer within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output list contains all N-bit binary numbers with more than or equal 1's than 0's for any prefix of the number.

postconditions.expression: all(len(x) == N for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each binary number in the output list has exactly N bits.

postconditions.expression: all(x.count('1') >= x.count('0') for x in output)
postconditions.description: For each binary number in the output list, the number of 1's is greater than or equal to the number of 0's.
The output list is sorted in decreasing order.
